messages:
noor: FYI spotted an acct with provisional going negative after a retry during a streaming toolcall. happened during a small canary failover. :eyes:
liam: any traces or quick logs?
noor: pasted excerpt, sanitized:
```
router.INFO: session=ses_AZ12 route=us-east-1 -> fallback=eu-west-2 reconnect=true prefetch=true
sidecar.DEBUG: prefetch_toolcall_id=ptc_333
router.DEBUG: outbound_headers: X-Toolcall-Idempotency: (not-present)
ledger.INFO: session=ses_AZ12 provisional_apply=+35 toolcall=ptc_333 truncated=true
ledger.INFO: session=ses_AZ12 reconcile_adjust=-48 reason=dedupe
ui.DEBUG: provisional_before=+35 provisional_after=-13
```
chao: looks like router dropped the idempotency header on fallback, target created a second toolcall, ledger later deduped causing UI negative.
liam: internal ledger can go negative for reconciliation, but the console must never show negative provisional. server-side clamp needed.
avery: (cc avery) will the clamp break any console math or exports? we should emit an audit flag when we clamp so CS can see real reconciles.
avery: ok. plan: show 0 in the balance, display a yellow banner "Billing correction applied during routing retry" with a link to the audit event. need a flag from ledger.
liam: I'll add a server-side clamp on the usage API and emit reconcile_reason tags (dedupe/fallback). hotfix to canary in ~90m.
chao: I'll patch router to copy prefetch_toolcall_id into X-Toolcall-Idempotency on fallback. Adding unit test for reconnect+fallback header propagation. ETA next canary.
noor: SRE repro steps added to PLAT-4010: enable prefetch, start stream with id header, kill connection mid-toolcall, allow fallback.
ops-bot: Alert: provisional_negative_detected acct=999 value=-13 canary=canary-2026-04 tags=[prefetch fallback]
liam: also adding telemetry metric billing.reconcile.dedupe rate so we can alert if frequency spikes.
avery: once liam's flag exists, I'll wire the banner to the audit link.
chao: note: be conservative copying headers only when prefetch=true to avoid leaking session ids across unrelated requests.
noor: thanks all. will watch canary and keep CS in the loop. closing here; followups in PLAT-4010.
